## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened.
-->
Home Assistant currently uses pywemo 0.4.34. The latest version is 0.4.41.

0.4.34 triggers a warning about deprecated Python behavior, which has been fixed in https://github.com/pavoni/pywemo/pull/117 and released as 0.4.35.

However, 0.4.35 also introduced breaking changes that require updates to Home Assitant as per @sqldiablo in https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/31360#issuecomment-580987525:
> This will require changes to the code in each wemo component in Home Assistant Core to be able to properly handle the new exceptions that PyWemo will throw on action errors instead of hiding them from the calling app.

This ticket is to track that we do this. Would be great if someone could pick this up.

## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Developer tools -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 108
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): -
- Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv): all
- Integration causing this issue: Wemo
